args.body:
Summary of websites posted in #general:

1. www.informations.com (posted by Bob): An article about the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com (posted by Eve): Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for its authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional Swiss dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. It offers a warm, rustic atmosphere with wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site is clean and simple, which makes it easy to navigate. I like that you've included your contact information directly on the page. If I could suggest one improvement, it would be to add more content about yourself — such as your background, interests, projects, or skills — to give visitors a better sense of who you are and what you do. Overall, it's a nice personal website with a solid foundation!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog highlights your favorite hobby — hiking! It's a great way to share your passion with others. To make your blog even more engaging, you might consider adding photos from your hikes, trail recommendations, or tips for fellow hikers. Also, I saw you mentioned the Zurich Restaurant in the general channel — a blog post combining your love of hiking with great dining spots nearby could be a fun read! Keep up the good work!
